$comment: Job DR B1: the seven ready-made task templates. The planner is shown them and may pick one (or 'custom'); the fake dialer answers the questions by their type. English labels and example instructions; the assistant's own wording to customers is written in the customer's language by the planner with the register block (drafts for native review).

templates.label: Call new leads
templates.goal: Call each new lead, say who we are, find out what they need and whether they want a visit or a quote.

questions.text: Would you like to visit or get a quote?

templates.example_instruction: Call all new leads from this week and ask what they need and whether they want a visit.

templates.label: Re-engage old leads
templates.goal: Write to leads who went quiet, ask if they still want to go ahead and invite them back.
templates.example_instruction: Message everyone who asked about us more than a month ago and ask if they are still interested.

templates.label: Confirm appointments
templates.goal: Confirm tomorrow's visits and appointments and reschedule the ones that no longer suit.

questions.text: Can you come at the booked time?
If not, which day suits you?

templates.example_instruction: Confirm everyone who has a store visit tomorrow and move the ones who cannot come.

templates.label: Collect feedback
templates.goal: Ask recent customers how it went and whether anything needs fixing.

questions.text: Were you happy with the service?

templates.example_instruction: Ask last week's customers if they were happy with the delivery.

templates.label: Payment reminder
templates.goal: Remind customers politely about a payment that is due, without arguing and without any amount that is not on the ledger.
templates.example_instruction: Remind the customers whose payment is overdue and ask when they can pay.

templates.label: Supplier price enquiry
templates.goal: Ask each supplier for today's price and delivery day for one product.

questions.text: What is your price per unit today?

templates.example_instruction: Ask my three cement suppliers their price per bag and when they can deliver.

templates.label: Offer or event invite
templates.goal: Invite customers to an offer or an event. Promotional: only people who agreed to hear from the business, and by WhatsApp unless a 140-series number is set up.
templates.example_instruction: Invite my customers who agreed to offers to the Diwali sale on Saturday.
